The best candidate reached a training NMSE of about 1.7e-4, which is still far from the 1e-12 that an exact law would give, so the structure is still wrong.

The best fitted form is `(a + b·t)·P·(1 − P/K) + c + d·P + e/P + f·P² + g·t·P³ + h·t·P² + i·t·√P`, with 1/P as the dominant low-density term.
